name: Mizuho Medy Co.,Ltd.
summary: Mizuho Medy Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of in vitro diagnostic products, and related scientific and technical information services in Japan. The company offers molecular diagnostic products, such as nucleic acid amplification test products comprising gene analysis instruments and mycoplasma pneumoniae nucleic acid kits.
